Why: the record shows only a **request** for an extension to 2026-10-14T10:00 at the next approval sitting. Under OPS-14 §3, a pending request is not permission, and permission given later cannot cover an earlier change. The next duty-manager sitting is Tuesday 09:00 — after today’s 13:30 release, 14:00 freeze, and 14:30 destruction. The manager also said no discretionary extensions this cycle and to release the full batch on time. Every extension/rework charge is audited, so an unauthorised re-date would be a policy breach.

So the compliant action is: leave the box on today’s outbound manifest, release on time, and add a clear note that the extension request remains pending for tomorrow’s sitting and that a Wednesday collection was booked — for the duty manager and audit trail — but not use that to hold, rework, or re-date the box today. Missing the 13:30 release would dispatch nothing and record the shift incomplete, so withholding the manifest over one box is not an available option either.
